SELECT id,company_name,company_address,contact_name, contact_mobile,contact_address,currency,company_state,create_time FROM sys_accounting_company sac WHERE delete_state=1
AND sac.company_state =#{params.state}
AND sac.${params.searchType} LIKE concat('%',#{params.searchKeyword},'%')
ORDER BY update_time DESC
